div.div: What do the stylists use that we do not sell?
the looks' garments with no catalog product
pairs of kinds counted across looks, per occasion
a photo compared with the lookbook's looks
the new items of tab 2's shoot against the lookbook

div.span: one question, three stores, the same definition of emerging

div.div: openCypher over the graph: counts per kind and value
then ask the data agent: SQL over the same rows
the garments' vectors grouped in the browser, each cloud described by a model
